lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-luminance circular spots is visible posterior to the gill slits. The arrangement follows a matrix pattern where spots are organized into vertical columns, with inter-spot distance increasing slightly along the posterior axis.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are visible, intersecting with horizontal carinae to form a grid. High-intensity blobs are positioned at the nodes where these vertical bands cross the horizontal ridges.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three primary horizontal ridges are visible across the mid-to-upper flank. These features are defined by a sharp intensity gradient, characterized by high-luminance highlights on the dorsal edges and low-luminance shadowing immediately ventral to the ridges.
